children: Spelunker Probe Droids are originally designed to enter subterranean areas to search for valuable ore deposits. When the Commerce Guild joins

, they hand the designs over to the Techno Union, which removes some of the mining-specific components and replaces them with advanced stealth systems. These modified Droids are often referred to as "Chameleon Droids."

undetected to key entry and exit points on the battlefield. A common tactic for Chameleon Droids is to invisibly lay down numerous
